That's the interview. Your realm is taking shape — every answer you gave has been offered up for your review. Accept what fits, reject what doesn't. Nothing was written without your say-so.

Import my notes

Already have a campaign written up? Paste your notes in the documented format below. Everything is read on your device — no AI, no internet. Each thing you wrote becomes a candidate you review and accept; nothing is added until you say so.

The format — four kinds of heading

Start each thing with a # heading. The lines under it fill in the details (Key: value). Anything that isn't one of the four headings is listed back to you as "couldn't read" — never silently dropped, so nothing gets lost.

# Faction: The Stonemasons Guild
Type: Economic            (Government | Opposition | Religious | Economic | Military)
Position: gaining         (holding | gaining | losing | fragmenting)
Description: Controls every quarry licence in the river valley.

# NPC: Mara Veldt
Role: Guildmistress
Description: Pragmatic, owed favours by half the council.

# Location: The Lower Cisterns
Description: Flooded vaults beneath the old mint.

# Event: The Quarry Collapse
Type: Economic            (Political | Military | Economic | Social | Natural | …)
Weight: -8                (-30 to 30 — how much it shook the realm)
Visibility: public        (public | secret)
Description: A tunnel gave way, halting the eastern works.

Field names are not case-sensitive. Leave out any line you don't need — only the heading name is required. v1 reads exactly these four kinds.

🎲 Tables

Roll tables that read your world — entirely offline. The same table surfaces a different result when a stat is in a band, a pressure is active, or the season turns. Every table you make is yours: it survives export and re-import. Rolling is task-resolution prompting; nothing is wagered.

🗣 Hold Audience

An in-character conversation clamped by a deterministic dossier. RealmWright compiles exactly what this character knows — public history, their own drives, only the secrets you grant — before any AI call. The model is given only that dossier, so it cannot reveal what it was never told. The card on the left is the proof; it works with no AI at all.

Settings

About

RealmWright · Version 2.3.0

Display
Theme
Ember (warm ceremonial dark), Manuscript (the cartographer's chart table — a light, cool survey-paper workspace), or Modern (cool command console dark).
Respect system motion preference
Disables animations when your OS has reduced-motion enabled
Show forecasts in chronicle
Forecast events (possible futures) appear alongside real events. Off by default.
Copilot
Provider
OpenRouter routes to any cloud model. Ollama runs a model locally on your machine — no API key, no data sent to any server.
OpenRouter API key
Stored locally only — never sent anywhere except OpenRouter. Get one free at openrouter.ai/keys
Model
Sonnet is the recommended balance of cost and reasoning. Haiku for fast/cheap; Opus for hard problems.
Ollama base URL
Default is http://localhost:11434. Make sure Ollama is running and CORS is open (OLLAMA_ORIGINS=*).
Ollama model
Must be pulled locally first: ollama pull llama3.1. Recommended: llama3.1, mistral, or gemma3.
Cost guardrails

The meter (top-left) always shows session spend. Both fields below are opt-in — leave blank to disable. Soft warn fires once per session. Hard cap pauses AI until you resume from the meter or raise the limit here.

Warn at (USD)
One-time toast when session spend crosses this number.
Pause at (USD)
Hard cap. AI is suspended until you click resume or raise this.
